title: Student Association of Taiwan, UW-Madison
content_html:
The Student Association of Taiwan (SAT) at the University of Wisconsin–Madison is a student organization serving Taiwanese students, local students, and international students at the university. Its founding year is not documented in available first-party sources. The organization is registered in the university’s Wisconsin Involvement Network (WIN) club directory under the slug “taiwanesestudent.”

SAT describes itself as a forum for students to meet, develop friendships, and bond in a friendly environment. Its stated mission is to bring students together across all fields of study for recreational, academic, and cultural purposes, and to serve as a channel of communication for its members. The organization explicitly welcomes students of all ethnicities and nationalities. The TUSO useful-resources page notes that SAT specifically pertains to graduate students, distinguishing it from the undergraduate-focused TUSO.

SAT maintains an active website at sat-uw-madison.com (a migration from earlier WordPress and Wix presences) and a Facebook page with over 1,200 likes. No verified Instagram handle for SAT was identified in first-party sources.
